sources.title: Android VPN developer guide
sources.supports: VpnService creates a local device interface and applies app/route scope.
sources.limitations: Does not establish that tethered clients traverse every app VPN.

sources.title: Tethering hardware offload
sources.supports: Tethering forwarding can take a hardware path and supports separate IPv4/IPv6 handling.
sources.limitations: Do not infer an app VPN captures that forwarded path; do not disable offload as a universal fix.

sources.title: Connect to VPN by Google on your Pixel device
sources.supports: The named VPN product excludes USB and Wi-Fi hotspot tethering traffic.
sources.limitations: Product-specific example; not proof that all third-party Android implementations behave identically.

sources.title: Share the internet connection from your iPhone or iPad with your Mac
sources.supports: Personal Hotspot uses cellular data and cannot share the Wi-Fi network the iPhone joined.
sources.limitations: Does not certify VPN inheritance. Search extraction succeeded; a later direct fetch returned 429.

sources.title: Clarification on Personal Hotspot traffic
sources.supports: Apple DTS identifies Personal Hotspot as a user feature rather than a developer API.
sources.limitations: The questioner's observation is not treated as a universal Apple guarantee.

sources.title: Official Guidance: Understanding Surge
sources.supports: Documents explicit proxy support requirements and iOS other-device proxy takeover limitations.
sources.limitations: Vendor-specific reference, not a product recommendation or proof of current phone behavior.

sources.title: RFC 9110 section 9.3.6 CONNECT
sources.supports: Ordinary CONNECT establishes a tunnel to a target server/port.
sources.limitations: An ordinary HTTP proxy setting does not prove UDP support; newer UDP-specific mechanisms require their own verified implementation.

sources.title: RFC 1928 section 7 UDP-based clients
sources.supports: SOCKS5 specifies a separate UDP association and datagram relay procedure.
sources.limitations: Support must exist at both endpoints; the specification alone does not prove an installed app implements UDP.

sources.title: VPN Hotspot README
sources.supports: The project describes VPN hotspot/repeater sharing with root requirements.
sources.limitations: No instruction to root a device; current release and implementation must be checked independently.

sources.title: Add Shizuku-powered rootless USB and Wi-Fi tethering, PR 5903
sources.supports: An open proposal documents rootless, privileged-shell-based tethering with version/platform conditions.
sources.limitations: Open when checked; not stable release proof, not independently tested hardware, not a default installation path.

sources.title: How to fix Wi-Fi connection problems
sources.supports: Documents model-specific inability to use Wi-Fi and hotspot simultaneously, including Pixel 7a.
sources.limitations: Exact device/firmware must be checked; broad Pixel-family compatibility language is insufficient.

sources.title: Learn when you will get software updates on Google Pixel phones
sources.supports: Support periods vary by model and start from the specified first-availability date.
sources.limitations: Used purchase date does not restart the policy; no generic Android support period is inferred.

sources.title: Apple security releases
sources.supports: Lists available security updates and device/OS eligibility.
sources.limitations: Current update eligibility is not a promise of a fixed future support period.

sources.title: Help keep your Pixel phone from feeling too warm or hot
sources.supports: Hotspot use, heavy transfers and charging can increase heat and trigger performance/radio limits.
sources.limitations: No model-independent thermal threshold or unattended-service endurance guarantee is claimed.

sources.title: Charge and maintain your iPhone battery
sources.supports: Heat and extended full-charge exposure affect battery life; charging protection should be respected.
sources.limitations: No claim that continuous charging is harmless or a short trial certifies sustained service.

no_hardware_claim: Source review and grammar/structure validation are not proof of phone, hotspot, public node, or all-platform execution.
